attempts.response:
NO_IMPROVEMENT
The xor+ror+test+setg sequence is already minimal because any correct single-compare needs a bijection moving LSB to MSB to make evens positive and odds negative while mapping 4 to 0, which requires at least xor/sub plus rotate.
